seo.title: Case Study: Jira Executive Dashboard | M20 Technology
seo.description: How M20 took a Jira visibility need from AI prototype to a secure, production-grade executive dashboard, with no data stored and no new budget.

hero.title: From Prototype to Production-Ready Executive Dashboard
hero.intro: How M20 Technology turned a real-time Jira visibility need into a secure, production-grade executive dashboard, without adding a new system of record.

overview.title: A Leading InsurTech Scaling Beyond Its Data Visibility
overview.text: The client is a leading insurance comparison platform. As the business scaled, their leadership team needed clearer visibility into project and team health, without adding another tool to their stack. Jira was already embedded across the organization. The opportunity was to surface that data in a way that actually served executives.

facts.value: Project health data existed in Jira, but it wasn't visible to the people who needed it most.

challenge.title: Executive Visibility Without a New System to Maintain
challenge.intro: Leadership lacked a clear view into project and portfolio health. Teams had resorted to building Google Sheets by hand to track status, because Jira's native views weren't built for a C-suite audience. The data lived in Jira. What was missing was a layer that could turn it into meaningful signals without creating a new system to maintain.

items.title: Limited visibility into project health
items.text: Leadership needed reliable, up-to-date project visibility, and the workarounds teams had built to provide it weren't scaling. The goal was to surface what already lived in Jira in a way that served executives, without adding another tool to manage.

items.title: Pass security and IT review
items.text: Jira had to remain the single system of record, with nothing replicated or stored. The solution had to mirror existing user permissions exactly, pass IT and security review, and be portable enough to deploy anywhere without platform lock-in.

items.title: Deliver within existing budget
items.text: There was no appetite for a new procurement cycle. The work had to be scoped and delivered within an existing support contract. That meant moving fast, prototyping intelligently with AI, and shipping something production-credible without a heavyweight commitment.

challenge.outro: An early AI prototyping phase proved the concept could be built quickly and securely, with a working Jira-connected dashboard demonstrated within days. That proof answered the budget question before a line of production code was written. Phase 1 also showed that the prototyping environment wasn't production-ready, so the project moved into a Git repository with a proper deployment pipeline from the start.

solution.title: A Secure, Host-Agnostic Architecture Built on Jira
solution.intro: We use AI as a tool to build precisely to spec, faster. This project moved from prototype to production in three deliberate phases, each one intentional.
solution.illustrationAlt: Three rising steps: a dashed prototype sketch, a Git-based pre-production build, and a secured production dashboard with a status table and RAG summary, all reading live from Jira.

parts.title: Backend
parts.text: **Node.js with Express.** Calls Jira Cloud on the user's behalf and returns only the fields the UI needs.

parts.title: Frontend
parts.text: **Cloud-native.** An executive-focused single-page application that compiles to portable static assets, deployable anywhere.

parts.title: Access
parts.text: **Flexible, permission-aware authentication.** The dashboard supported both OAuth and API key authentication, giving teams options based on their security posture. Either way, it surfaces only what users can already see in Jira, with no new access rules to manage.

principles.title: Key design principles
items: **Single source of truth.** Jira is queried on demand. Nothing is replicated or stored.
**Cloud-native development.** Runs anywhere, configured via environment, with no platform lock-in.
**Minimal data transfer.** The server returns only the fields the UI requires, nothing more.
**AI-embracing.** Use AI to build exactly to spec, faster, rather than reaching for off-the-shelf solutions.

outcomes.title: Credible for Leadership. Comfortable for Security. Ready to Scale.
outcomes.intro: The client now has an Executive Dashboard that passes Security & IT review, earns executive confidence, and gives engineering a clear, low-risk path from proof of concept to production deployment.
items: Delivered a secure, Jira-connected Executive Dashboard with real-time portfolio visibility for leadership.
Established a GitHub-based delivery model meeting enterprise standards for traceability and security review.
Zero data stored: Jira remains the single source of truth with no residual footprint.
Produced documentation covering data flow, configuration, and operations, written for developers and IT alike.
Delivered a proof of concept that engineering, security, and leadership teams all have confidence in.

value.title: Why the Project Moved Quickly
value.intro: Three things worked together: deep relationships with the people in the room, a clear process for getting from brief to production, and the technical tools to execute without overhead.

items.title: A partner who knows the organization
items.text: M20 has worked across the client's operations, software, and leadership teams over a long-standing engagement. We understood internal governance, how decisions get made, and what security needs to approve before the first line of code was written.

items.title: Expertise across the stack
items.text: Atlassian platform knowledge, cloud-native development, and an understanding of governance requirements sat in one team. That let us speak to both what leadership needs to see and what IT needs to approve, without translation.

items.title: Rapid prototyping to production
items.text: AI-assisted prototyping validated the concept, a Git-based pre-production environment made it ownable, and a full production pipeline made it scalable. That's a way of working, not just a technical choice.
